A1.justification: Both PDFs describe UAR-Scenes, and all supplied pages, equations, tables, and figures are readable. v1 includes supplementary Section 6, which is absent from the supplied v2; this document-level omission is distinguishable from an extraction failure.

before.justification: v1 reports original RealEstate-10K and KITTI-v2 experiments, interpolation/extrapolation results, component ablations, and qualitative reconstructions.

after.justification: v2 retains the original experimental results in Tables 1–4 and reports qualitative reconstructions.

M1.justification: Sections 3.1–3.4 retain the same initialization, MotionCtrl pseudo-views, semantic entropy weighting, Fourier style transfer, scale constraints, and Gaussian refinement. Corrected symbols and Figure 2 loss notation do not establish a procedural change.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate RealEstate-10K and out-of-domain KITTI-v2, including narrow/wide-baseline synthesis and interpolation/extrapolation. Exchanging illustrative indoor scenes does not introduce different task or domain coverage.

E2.justification: The comparator membership in Tables 1–3 is identical. Newly cited works such as DepthSplat and MVSplat360 are not added as evaluated comparator rows.

E3.justification: The shared experiments retain the same metrics, 1079 KITTI test images, 50 diffusion sampling steps, and 1000 refinement iterations. Omitted supplementary preprocessing details reduce documentation without establishing a changed experimental protocol.

E4.justification: Table 4 and the Figure 5 component ablation are unchanged. Qualitative error cases are revised: v2 Figure 4 adds bedroom window completion, reuses the living-room mismatch example from v1 Figure 7, and omits several earlier illustrative cases.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run counts, seeds, error bars, confidence intervals, or significance tests. The retained semantic uncertainty maps are method components rather than statistical uncertainty estimates for experimental results.

E6.justification: All numerical results in Tables 1–4 are unchanged, including extrapolation FID 2.55 and KITTI PSNR 22.31 for UAR-Scenes. Qualitative result entries change through the added bedroom example and omission of several v1 examples; the living-room result is reused.

T1.justification: v2 omits the supplementary definitions and formulations in v1 Sections 6.1–6.2, including Gaussian covariance, rasterization, and latent diffusion Equations 7–11. The main mathematical formulation and Equations 1–6 remain unchanged; no theorem or proof is added.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution list, and conclusion retain the same claims about single-image scene refinement, uncertainty weighting, texture alignment, and generalization. The lightly rewritten conclusion does not substantively change their scope.

C2.justification: The qualification in v2 Figure 4 that plausible completions can differ from ground truth already appeared in v1 Figure 7. Explanations concerning oversaturation, confidence weighting, scale instability, and cross-domain applicability are substantively retained.

D1.justification: v2 omits substantial supplementary reproducibility information: 14-frame forward/backward generation, KITTI camera handling and cropping, video FPS/speed settings, and the specific BLIP2 variant and one-shot prompts. It adds a project-page link and a note on FID reporting sources, but the linked contents are not established by the supplied PDFs.

R1.justification: v2 adds citations to DepthSplat, Denoising Diffusion via Image-Based Rendering, the LPIPS paper, and MVSplat360, while dropping the few-shot-learning reference accompanying the omitted supplement. Section 2 also replaces categorical criticism of object-level, inconsistent diffusion with more qualified criticism of conditioning cost and possible inconsistency.

P1.justification: The main section sequence and most prose remain intact. Changes include localized wording and notation corrections, a lightly rewritten conclusion, added acknowledgments, and omission of the supplementary Section 6.

P2.justification: Figure 4 is recomposed, Figure 5 is relocated, Tables 2–4 are repositioned, and Figure 2's loss label is corrected. The supplementary prompting diagram and unused Figure 7 panels disappear, while its living-room panel moves into Figure 4.

improvement.justification: v2 adds useful attribution, a project link, and small editorial corrections, but omits the concrete preprocessing, video-generation, and prompting instructions supplied in v1 Section 6 and Figure 6 while retaining references to supplementary material. With the core method and quantitative evidence unchanged, these gains do not offset the reduced reproducibility and self-contained explanation in the supplied PDF.
